profile_text.body:
Rytr is an AI writing assistant and content generator, according to its own website. The site describes it as a free AI writer and writing assistant that lets users craft content faster, with a free starting tier and paid upgrades as users grow. Its product is tracked in the writing and editing category, where it is noted for marketing copy.

The site presents customer testimonials praising the tool's speed and accuracy, including one user who said a friend could not believe the text was written by AI, and another who called it the best AI writing tool they had tried. No lawsuits, regulatory filings, patent records, or MCP servers are associated with the company in the available material.
